title: Cervical Spine MRI Analysis
summary_en: Interpretable cervical MRI analysis spanning anatomical segmentation, clinical measurements, and spinal-cord T2 hyperintensity detection.
summary_zh: 面向颈椎MRI的可解释分析，覆盖解剖分割、临床测量与脊髓T2高信号检测。
clinical_motivation_en: Cervical spondylosis assessment requires consistent interpretation of multiple anatomical structures, compression patterns, and signal abnormalities.
clinical_motivation_zh: 颈椎病评估需要一致地解释多种解剖结构、压迫模式与信号异常。
technical_focus_en: Pathology-guided segmentation, automated imaging indicators, uncertainty-aware anomaly detection, and external validation.
technical_focus_zh: 病理引导分割、影像指标自动计算、不确定性感知异常检测与外部验证。

image.alt_en: Cover artwork depicting cervical MRI analysis and human-AI collaboration
image.alt_zh: 描绘颈椎MRI分析与人机协作的封面图

title: Interpretable Vertebral Fracture Assessment
summary_en: Pseudo-healthy vertebral synthesis and relative height-loss measurement for quantitative CT-based compression-fracture assessment.
summary_zh: 利用伪健康椎体合成与相对高度损失测量，实现基于CT的压缩性骨折定量评估。
clinical_motivation_en: Compression-fracture grading is difficult when no pre-fracture reference is available and deformity varies across the vertebral body.
clinical_motivation_zh: 缺少骨折前参照且椎体不同区域变形不一致，使压缩性骨折分级具有挑战。
technical_focus_en: Anatomy-informed image synthesis, quantitative height-loss mapping, and interpretable grading.
technical_focus_zh: 解剖先验图像合成、定量高度损失映射与可解释分级。

image.alt_en: HealthiVert-GAN artwork showing pseudo-healthy vertebra synthesis and height-loss measurement
image.alt_zh: HealthiVert-GAN封面图，展示伪健康椎体合成与高度损失测量

title: Generalizable Medical Anomaly Detection
summary_en: Translation-, reconstruction-, and uncertainty-based methods for detecting abnormalities across brain and spinal MRI.
summary_zh: 研究基于翻译、重建与不确定性的医学异常检测方法，覆盖脑MRI与脊髓MRI。
clinical_motivation_en: Rare and heterogeneous lesions make exhaustive annotation difficult, while acquisition changes can produce false anomaly signals.
clinical_motivation_zh: 病灶稀少且异质，难以获得穷尽标注；成像变化还可能造成虚假异常信号。
technical_focus_en: Cross-sequence translation, content-style disentanglement, cyclic inference, dual-level evidence, and uncertainty-guided learning.
technical_focus_zh: 跨序列翻译、内容风格解耦、循环推理、双层证据与不确定性引导学习。
